# Travel Policy (rev. 2025-03)

- Domestic per diem for meals is $75 per day. International per diem is $110 per day.
- Hotel cap is $260 per night in tier-1 cities (San Francisco, New York, Boston) and $190 elsewhere.
- Economy class is required for flights under 6 hours. Premium economy is allowed for flights of 6 hours or longer.
- Expense reports must be submitted within 30 days of trip end.
- Trips over $5,000 need VP approval before booking.
